newsitem.title: SPAIN: Unisource/AT&T could have new partner in 2 months.
newsitem.headline: Unisource/AT&T could have new partner in 2 months.

text.p: An AT&T -Unisource group official said on Tuesday the alliance could announce a new partner within the next two months, and it could come from as far afield as the Far East.

"We are looking for new partners to replace Telefonica and we could be making new organisational announcements in the next two months," Peter de Weerd, vice president of channel management, told a telecoms conference in Madrid.
"The partner could be from the Far East -- it's about time a telecoms operator from the Far East came to Europe -- but we will be very careful with a new partner," he later told Reuters.

Telefonica de Espana was asked to leave the Unisource group after announcing it would join forces with Concert, a rival alliance between British Telecommunications and U.S.-based MCI Communications Corp.
The Unisource partners of Koninklijke PTT Nederland, Swiss Telecom PTT and Telia of Sweden are teamed up with U.S. group AT&T Corp in a business communications venture called AT&T Unisource.
"Telefonica joined Unisource just a year ago and so was not that active... but it will be a tough, though business-like, divorce," De Weerd said.
